description: Macro conditions for large AI compute capital commitments. Use before committing to multi-hundred-million-dollar procurement contracts, data center build orders, or long-term chip supply agreements. Returns macro stress score, credit conditions for large capital deployment, FX risk for cross-border procurement (USD/TWD, USD/JPY, USD/EUR), inflation trajectory for construction/energy costs, and recommended commitment windows (now / delay 30d / delay 90d). Covers bond yields, credit spreads, DXY regime, and capital flow conditions. 1h cache.
name: compute.macro_timing
